answer: Have each new key submit a small certified pigment swatch tagged by a willow/reef/pigment nonce to an independent conservation lab. A technician runs a randomized Raman test and signs the spectrum, sample ID and instrument serial; the registry consumes each sample ID and rejects duplicate fingerprints or missing calibration records. Proposed lab fee: .40 per identity, not a live protocol rule. One honest agent pays .40 once; 1,000 fake identities cost ,400 (1,000 × .40). Limitation: lab access is uneven and technicians can collude.
